choices.reason: Rule 1 retains the adjusted estimates because the paper explicitly calls the model controlling for individual characteristics primary. choices.reason: No rule uniquely selects a pairwise contrast: all three use the same semantic-similarity measure in the same full-sample Day 2 analysis, and no pair is designated primary. Copilot is closest to free chatbot use but appears in two candidates; the diversity analysis specifies neither a common reference that resolves those pairs nor a combined-arm contrast.
